You have irregular periods. So you are taking estrogen and progesterone to regularize your cycles. It is not possible to conceive without ovulation. So you need to get your follicle growth monitored by repeated ultrasound. When follicle size reaches more than 17 mm, take injection for rupturing the follicle. Be in contact with your husband for next 2 days after injection. Take progesterone for next 2 weeks. Do a urine pregnancy test at home after that.

You have history of kidney infection. It can cause chronic renal failure. So better to consult your doctor and get done routine hologram, urine RE/ME, ultrasound abdomen and pelvis. If needed go for culture and sensitivity test of urine. Then start appropriate treatment accordingly.

I am sorry to hear about your husbands' experience with his appendix surgery. It is true that some patients can have very long healing times after their surgeries. However, there are many factors that affect how quickly someone heals. For example, if they smoke, have diabetes, or take certain medications, these things can slow down the healing process. Also, sometimes people get infections during their recovery which can also cause delays in healing.

As per your query you have symptoms of pain in jaw while chewing which can be due to temporomandibular joint disorder. Need not worry. I would suggest you to consult oral physician once and get evaluated. Doctor may order x-ray of jaw and take impression of teeth. Doctor may prescribe muscle relaxant like chlorzoxazone along with analgesics like ibuprofen. Doctor may also refer you to physiotherapist for further treatment. Doctor may also recommend splint to wear at night.

You are having symptoms of burning sensation during urination. This can be due to infection of urinary tract. You need to get your routine urine test done to rule out infection. If you are having fever then you may need culture sensitivity test for further work up.

You are having alcoholic hepatitis. It can be due to alcohol intake or other causes like viral infection. You should go for complete blood count, liver function test, viral markers, ultrasound abdomen. Then you should take treatment accordingly.

Your report suggests that you have high cholesterol level. You should take low fat diet, avoid saturated fats like butter, ghee, meat etc. Take more of fruits and vegetables in your diet. Avoid smoking and alcohol if any. Regular exercise will be helpful. Consult your doctor for further management.

You are having irregular menses. It can be due to hormonal imbalance or some other cause. You should consult gynecologist and go for examination. If needed go for ultrasound of pelvis. Then you should take treatment accordingly.

You are having history of smoking, surgery and cancer. Smoking is the major cause of all these problems. So first you should quit smoking. If you don't want to quit then at least reduce your smoking habit. Because smoking causes many complications like lung cancer, bronchitis, emphysema etc. It also causes many other diseases. So better to avoid smoking completely.

PFO (patent foramen ovale) is a congenital defect of the heart. It is present at birth and does not cause any symptoms unless there is an associated condition like atrial fibrillation. The hole can be closed surgically if it causes symptoms. If you do not want surgery then you need to take anticoagulants like warfarin during pregnancy.
